subject: general
question: In a certain code language, if GROUND is written as FPWQTI and STICKER is written as TGMEKVU, then what will STUDENT be written as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:

GROUND is written as FPWQTI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/714999ddd85ba5362251933bebb03ad0c0644dc658518e96bc8fe622d1695317.png] 

STICKER is written as TGMEKVU,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b31935a88d206e5f47268b9198983bfdb49103ae587e5d04542f7a9d96941432.png] 

Similarly, **STUDENT **will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb54b648c0e450d596fd1415445d1e0328a5f618a68975ee5d070876f2ebc460.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"VPGFWVU".**
